description: The Notes for App Review (App Store review, Google Play review) and the TestFlight What to Test text of one builder build, written only from what AppForShare knows of the app (brief, screens, backend sign in and data, live content, permissions). Without ai: the last AI notes of the build, else the template notes (free). ai: true asks Gemini to write them from the same facts: one AI action of the plan's monthly AI actions (cached per facts; fresh: true writes them again); tell the person, ask, and pass confirm: true. source = template or ai. The person reads and edits the text before a send; nothing goes to a store from here. Developer role for ai. Every plan with an account.

ai.description: Write them with AI (one AI action)

confirm.description: true when ai is true, after the person agreed

fresh.description: With ai: write them again instead of the cached answer

name: builder_review_notes
title: Store review notes for a builder build
